notes.title: Epic Update Ever
notes.notes:
Dear Seek Love players, after 3 years, we have finally optimized this 7 years old game, it is now fully optimized, we have finally solved the bugs that have existed since the beginning of the game and have never been able to be fixed, now Seek Love doesn't have any latency, there is also no delay in the control, so come and play it again!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33900240/db0be0012e44a51d48a29bbb0ed6fba59dbfbe04.png

notes.title: Final Update
notes.notes: We managed to fully optimize this 4 year old game. The smoothness of the graphics has been improved to the maximum. And reduced the size again. We have also added the vertical sync option. Finally, our new game will be released soon!

notes.title: Game Poster Image Update
notes.notes:
We have updated the game poster image.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33900240/b5a2ded0566de732c2cdd19aa42212be2cb2d6a1.png

notes.title: Huge Update
notes.notes: Through 72 hours of continuous optimization, we re-rendered the lighting to make the game's picture more beautiful and run more smoothly, also successfully reduced the size of the game to less than 5GB. One last thing, our new game will be released in the second half of the year.

notes.title: Small Update at the Beginning of 2020
notes.notes: At the beginning of 2020, we repaired some minor details. Thank you very much for your continued support! We will release a new game soon, so stay tuned!
